Hi Marissa — thank you for the clear list. A few quick clarifications before we confirm delivery: 

1) Audit period: our policy requires coverage for calendar year 2026 (Jan 1 2026 — Dec 31 2026). If your report ends earlier or starts later we will need a bridge letter confirming controls in the missing months. 
2) Logs and monitoring: procurement also asked whether you can provide evidence that 90-day operational logs and retention controls are in place (examples: SIEM ingestion summary, retention policy doc). If you can list which log types are available in the evidence index, that would be helpful.
3) SIG/CAIQ: we'd prefer a CAIQ if it is easier for your team; otherwise SIG Lite is acceptable.

SFTP is preferred for our security team. Please create a one-time SFTP account and email transfer details to security@acmecorp.com.

Also — please confirm whether there are any contractual terms we need executed (NDA, DPA) prior to transfer.

Regards,
Jordan
